# api-lifecycle

Lifecycle from draft to deprecation - contract-first, dated deprecation, measured retirement.

## Recipes

- `apiforge model api-gateway --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge model asyncapi --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge knowledge show api-lifecycle`
- `apiforge judge` then filter findings by rules AF-BREAK-005, AF-BREAK-006, AF-CONTRACT-001
